doc.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

title: No residuals and hearing himself on the radio
summary: Studio work was flat fee; Pallo seldom hears himself on the radio.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Do you get, I guess what the word might be, residuals or payments for your studio work that you did?
No. All that was all flat fee, the studio work.
You ever go in your car and some song comes on the radio and you say oh I’m on that.
Very, very seldom because I don’t listen to a lot of those stations. But every once in a while I’ll hear it. I’ll say oh yeah I remember that now.
